mechanism: Paroxetine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing albendazole metabolite concentrations and CNS exposure; albendazole may also induce certain CYP enzymes affecting paroxetine levels.
action: Monitor for increased albendazole adverse effects (dizziness, headache) and paroxetine efficacy; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical vigilance recommended.
